abstract.t: This document describes an infrastructure-assisted approach to AI-agent discovery. An orchestration, placement, or hosting system can publish current deployment and reachability information for available AI-agent services or instances. Separately, network infrastructure can derive an abstract Attachment Scope representing the network context applicable to a requester. A discovery mechanism combines requester intent, currently published AI-agent resources, and the requester's Attachment Scope to identify applicable agent instances.
